$description: Canonical visual identity tokens for the Banza payment network. Single source of truth. Do not fork.

primary.name: Space Cherry
primary.description: Primary brand color. Use for CTAs, active states, key UI elements.

primaryHighlight.name: Cherry Highlight
primaryHighlight.description: Lighter cherry for gradients, hover states, elevated surfaces.

primaryShadow.name: Deep Shadow
primaryShadow.description: Darkest cherry. Use for pressed states, depth, icon shadows.

surfaceLight.name: Soft White
surfaceLight.description: Primary light surface. Warm, not pure white. Default page background in light mode.

surfaceNeutral.name: Soft Neutral Shadow
surfaceNeutral.description: Subtle neutral for borders, dividers, and muted text on light surfaces.

nearBlack.name: Near Black
nearBlack.description: Primary text color. Near-black, not pure black — warmer and more refined.

brand.name: Brand Gradient
brand.description: Canonical Banza background gradient. Use for splash screens, hero surfaces, QR frames, payment confirmation screens.

surface.name: Light Surface Gradient
surface.description: Canonical light mode surface gradient. Use for card backs, modal backgrounds, dashboard panels.

icon.philosophy: Soft physical depth with restrained luxury lighting.
icon.style: Apple-like rounded rectangle container with four-quadrant modular symbol
icon.shadow: subtle drop shadow, 8% opacity, 2px blur, 1px Y offset

typography.note: Typography tokens are defined per-app. Brand assets use system fonts only.
